2.source: relic set 306 (停转的萨尔索图 / Inert Salsotto), 2-piece: "Increases the wearer's CRIT Rate by #1[i]%. When the wearer's current CRIT Rate is equal to or higher than #2[i]%, increases the DMG dealt by the wearer's Ultimate and Follow-Up ATK by #3[i]%." param = [0.08, 0.5, 0.15]
2.note: Two effects because "Ultimate and Follow-Up ATK" names two scopes the engine models separately: ULTIMATE_DAMAGE_BOOST is picked by the cast's category (`Damage.getCastCategory()`), FOLLOW_UP_DAMAGE_BOOST by the damage type (`DamageType.ADDITIONAL`). One all-type boost would buff basic attacks and skills as well -- an over-trigger, not a near miss. ⚠ Threshold as a fraction (0.5 = 50%), see set 304's note. ⚠ The wearer's own +8% CRIT Rate from this set is already in the sheet before BATTLE_START fires, so "current CRIT Rate" includes it, as the text intends.
